# The package an openapi: import writes, run against the local server the
# script harness runs at 127.0.0.1:47819 (internal/testhttp) on
# every target.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '5 tests, 0 failures'
stderr 'import "openapi:./petstore.yml": field breed_lineage of PetBreedDetail is left out: a map of any value'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '5 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '5 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
// The package an openapi: import writes, run against the local server: a
// function called from a test with server set for it, a 404 classified, a
// query written from a function's parameters, and the adapter component
// asking again when its key changes, and when its `refresh` is called.

import async "sngl:async"
import pets "openapi:./petstore.yml"
import . "sngl:test"
import . "sngl:ui"

const local = "http://127.0.0.1:47819"

func testRetrieve(t Test) {
    t.setContext(pets.server, local)
    match var p = pets.petRetrieveCall(id="rex") {
        ok {
            t.assert(p.id == 1)
            t.assert(p.adoptionFee == 120)
            t.assert(p.tags.length() == 2)
            t.assert(p.tags[1].type.name == "small")
            t.assert(p.photos.thumbnailUrl == "https://example.com/1.png")
            t.assert(p.measurements[0].baseValue == 45)
        }
        failed { t.assert(p.message == "") }
    }
}

func testNotFound(t Test) {
    t.setContext(pets.server, local)
    match var f = pets.petRetrieveCall(id="nobody") {
        ok { t.assert(false) }
        failed {
            t.assert(f.kind == async.FailureKind.request)
            t.assert(f.code == "404")
        }
    }
}

func testListQuery(t Test) {
    t.setContext(pets.server, local)
    match var page = pets.petListCall(limit=2, offset=1) {
        ok {
            t.assert(page.count == 5)
            t.assert(page.results.length() == 2)
            t.assert(page.results[0].name == "bella")
            t.assert(page.next != null)
            t.assert(page.previous != null)
        }
        failed { t.assert(page.message == "") }
    }
}

component pager node {
    var offset = 0
    var page option[pets.PaginatedPetSummaryList] = null
    pets.server(local) {
        pets.petList(limit=2, offset=offset, :value=page)
    }
    text #first(value=page != null && page.results.length() > 0 ? page.results[0].name : "-")
    button #more(text="More", @click { offset += 2 })
}

func testAdapterAsksAgain(t Test, c pager) {
    t.wait(func() => c.first.value == "rex", 5000)
    t.assert(c.first.value == "rex")
    c.more.click()
    t.wait(func() => c.first.value == "milo", 5000)
    t.assert(c.first.value == "milo")
}

component retrier node {
    var fails = 0
    pets.server(local) {
        pets.petRetrieve #lookup(id="nobody", @fail { fails += 1 })
    }
    text #failed(value="{fails}")
    button #retry(text="Retry", @click { lookup.refresh() })
}

func testAdapterRefreshes(t Test, c retrier) {
    t.wait(func() => c.failed.value == "1", 5000)
    c.retry.click()
    t.wait(func() => c.failed.value == "2", 5000)
    t.assert(c.failed.value == "2")
}

window {
    pager
}
-- petstore.yml --
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: Petstore
  version: 1.0.0
servers:
- url: https://petstore.example
paths:
  /api/v1/pets/:
    get:
      operationId: pet_list
      summary: List pets
      parameters:
      - name: limit
        required: false
        in: query
        description: Number of results to return per page.
        schema:
          type: integer
      - name: offset
        required: false
        in: query
        description: The initial index from which to return the results.
        schema:
          type: integer
      responses:
        '200':
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PaginatedPetSummaryList'
          description: ''
  /api/v1/pets/{id}/:
    get:
      operationId: pet_retrieve
      summary: Get pet
      parameters:
      - in: path
        name: id
        schema:
          type: string
        description: This parameter can be a string or an integer.
        required: true
      responses:
        '200':
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetDetail'
          description: ''
  /api/v1/pet-breeds/{id}/:
    get:
      operationId: pet_breed_retrieve
      summary: Get pet breed
      parameters:
      - in: path
        name: id
        schema:
          type: string
        required: true
      responses:
        '200':
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetBreedDetail'
          description: ''
components:
  schemas:
    PaginatedPetSummaryList:
      type: object
      required:
      - count
      - next
      - previous
      - results
      properties:
        count:
          type: integer
          example: 123
        next:
          type: string
          nullable: true
          format: uri
        previous:
          type: string
          nullable: true
          format: uri
        results:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetSummary'
    PetSummary:
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
          maxLength: 200
        url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          readOnly: true
      required:
      - name
      - url
    PetDetail:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: integer
          readOnly: true
        name:
          type: string
          maxLength: 200
        adoption_fee:
          type:
          - integer
          - 'null'
        age:
          type:
          - integer
          - 'null'
        is_available:
          type: boolean
        breed:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetBreedSummary'
        photos:
          allOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetPhotos'
          readOnly: true
        measurements:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetMeasurement'
          readOnly: true
        tags:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetTag'
          readOnly: true
      required:
      - id
      - name
      - breed
      - photos
      - measurements
      - tags
    PetPhotos:
      type: object
      properties:
        thumbnail_url:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
      required:
      - thumbnail_url
    PetMeasurement:
      type: object
      properties:
        base_value:
          type: integer
        margin:
          type: integer
        measure:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/MeasureSummary'
      required:
      - base_value
      - margin
      - measure
    MeasureSummary:
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
        url:
          type: string
          format: uri
      required:
      - name
      - url
    PetTag:
      type: object
      properties:
        slot:
          type: integer
        type:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/TagSummary'
      required:
      - slot
      - type
    TagSummary:
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
        url:
          type: string
          format: uri
      required:
      - name
      - url
    PetBreedSummary:
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
        url:
          type: string
          format: uri
      required:
      - name
      - url
    PetBreedDetail:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: integer
        name:
          type: string
        parent_breed:
          oneOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetBreedSummary'
          - type: 'null'
        breed_lineage:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: {}
      required:
      - id
      - name
      - parent_breed
